q: Quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for MaxCut uses p layers of alternating phase and mixing unitaries. At p = 1, the achievable approximation ratio for MaxCut on 3-regular graphs is:
exp: QAOA at depth p=1: Farhi-Goldstone-Gutmann computed the expected cut value for 3-regular graphs as 0.6924... of the optimal MaxCut. This is below the Goemans-Williamson SDP bound of 0.878... (assuming Unique Games Conjecture is optimal). Higher p gives better approximations but the advantage over classical is unclear.
